annotation.bound_parties_text: The draft standard sets safety requirements for industrial mobile robots with actively controlled stability, with hazards assessed in relation to use as intended and misuse reasonably foreseeable by the manufacturer.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: under specified conditions of misuse which are reasonably foreseeable by the manufacturer.
annotation.legal_effect_quote: A draft is being reviewed by the committee.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Robotics — Safety requirements for dynamically stable industrial mobile robots (legged, wheeled, or other forms of locomotion) — Part 1: Robots
